comment: Weekly 12-month TSMOM short. Not bear_regime_cover. Cash while 12m return >= 0. No 2x ATR.
_mechanics: Once per completed UTC week: short BTC 50% if BTC close / close[52w] - 1 < 0. Short ETH 50% only if BTC and ETH 12m returns are both negative. Cover a name when its 12m return is no longer negative (ETH also covers if BTC 12m flips up). No ATR stop. cat_stop_pct=0 on first score.
